items.text: Fixed excessive AI Agent token usage when adding missing image alternative text.
Fixed excessive AI Agent token usage when adding aria-label attributes to interaction triggers.
Fixed Accordion title size and alignment being overridden by option group presets.
Fixed Button option group presets failing to show an icon when the default element preset disabled it.
Fixed inconsistent heading sizes in the Visual text editor when headings contained inline markup.
Fixed the Divi Layout Block builder getting stuck loading in the WordPress 7.1 Block Editor.
Fixed Section Divider Horizontal Repeat 0x rendering the same shape as 1x.
Fixed Image Module Link copying, extension and preset resetting to preserve unrelated image fields.

Clipboard entries now preserve the copied module type through cache serialization. Image Content paste therefore retains lightbox after the source module is deleted or the user navigates to another page. Older clipboard entries still use the live-source fallback.
Divi 5 modules display their names in the WordPress Block Editor’s Document Overview List View.
Fixed an issue that allowed users to access custom-field metadata for posts they did not have permission to edit.
Fixed Slider navigation becoming unresponsive while editing a child Slide in the Visual Builder.
Fixed newly promoted Main canvases losing their layouts after leaving Canvas Grid View.
Fixed Menu Text hover transforms moving surrounding header elements when enabled through Composable Settings.
Fixed canvas right-click actions, clipboard operations, library saves, and module movement using the wrong layout content.
Fixed an issue where default Element Presets could override assigned Option Group Presets in the Visual Builder.
Fixed Gallery responsive width descriptors and measured larger-image selection for wide cells, while avoiding eager automatic original selection and preserving custom-fit thumbnails.
Added a public API for third-party developers to register custom AI Agent tools, with user trust controls, a Tools Catalog management UI, and developer documentation.
Fixed authorization checks for local code snippet favorites, categories, tags and source duplication.
Fixed oversized, right-aligned stars overlapping their rating labels in the Woo Product Reviews module.
Fixed preset grid offset rules reappearing after being deleted from an individual module.
Fixed parent Blurb layout and Text typography settings affecting nested modules of the same type.
Fixed Post Filter Reset leaving a radio option selected after reloading a filtered page.
Fixed font dropdown jumps during arrow-key navigation in the Visual Builder.
Fixed Button group preset icons overriding locally selected icons on hover when using left icon placement.
Added missing sticky-post and current-post exclusion options in Theme Builder templates, including current-page queries.
Fixed slow backend saves when Divi's static CSS cache contains many directories.
Updated AI Agent HTML cleanup in Text modules to use compact discovery and reduce token usage.
Fixed loop excerpts including the outer page title and unrelated canvas content.
Enabled video, pattern, and mask backgrounds for Menu Text links.
Fixed Divi Library batch imports counting a timed-out file as both failed and successful.
Improved settings-search performance by reducing repeated tooltip lookup work.
Fixed blurry YouTube thumbnails in Slider, Fullwidth Slider and upload previews.
Fixed collapsed or disappearing video slides in Visual Builder.
Fixed blank video slides after overlapping navigation, responsive changes or revealing hidden containers.
Fixed incorrect slide control colors after interrupted navigation and slider reinitialization.
Fixed hidden Video Slider playback restarting after an interrupted departure.
Fixed partially faded Gallery images after slider reinitialization.
Fixed unauthorized access to post content and layout-preview data through Divi Layout block requests.
Fixed shortcode previews exposing data from posts the current user cannot read.
Fixed responsive Image module margins displaying differently in the Visual Builder and frontend.
Added WordPress Abilities discovery and approval-based execution to the Divi AI Agent, including read-only execution in Ask mode.
Fixed entrance animations breaking native CSS sticky positioning on the front end in browsers supporting overflow clipping.
Added an explicit Static positioning option while preserving Default positioning.
Fixed loop product dynamic prices ignoring WooCommerce shop tax display settings.
Fixed responsive column widths defined in presets not applying on the frontend.
Fixed unexpected scrolling when selecting layers on pages with Theme Builder templates.
Fixed a JavaScript error on WooCommerce checkout pages when a Divi-built Terms and Conditions page contained section dividers.
Fixed an issue where Divi AI image variant swaps could change image framing.
Fixed background images disappearing on the front end when saved parallax settings omit an enabled value.
Fixed duplicate Section CSS generated by overlapping default option group preset sources.
Fixed loading saved layouts and existing pages containing presets and global variables for users with Editor permissions.
Fixed the Post Filter Item field label appearing twice on the front end when the field type differs between desktop and mobile.
Fixed a builder error and restored column-count changes in migrated Block specialty inner-row settings.
Fixed accordion items scrolling out of view when large sticky sections leave no visible scroll destination.
Fixed custom attribute sanitization so users without unfiltered HTML permission cannot save event handlers through flat attribute lists.
Fixed composable settings failing to enable automatically when compatible option group presets were assigned between composite and direct option groups.
Fixed the color picker resetting its selected hue when choosing black or gray colors.
Fixed preset-based Grid layouts missing Grid styles or rendering columns too narrowly on published pages.
Fixed tablet-width Sidebar widgets in Divi 5 while preserving full-width phone behavior.
Restored undo shortcuts while editing Chart table values.
Fixed Group Carousel Groups layout defaults and alignment icons to match the vertical group direction.
Fixed cleared transform values generating invalid CSS that prevented other transforms from applying.
Improved Divi AI agent efficiency by keeping only the latest module data in later AI requests.
Fixed an issue where a user who could edit posts could permanently delete or change a global canvas they were not allowed to manage.
Fixed an issue where a user who can edit posts could permanently delete Divi Library layouts and Theme Builder templates.
Deleted global elements will no longer display their local instances on the front end.
Fixed Post Filter parent bottom margins while preserving unset gutter and specialty-column defaults.
Fixed vertical alignment of action icons in the canvas selector.
Fixed HTML icons in navigation labels appearing as literal markup when displayed through an Icon List menu loop.
Fixed extending column attributes to a parent row also affecting nested columns.
Fixed Contact Form field hover shadows from presets.
Fixed phone-width grid rows whose columns exceeded the row container.
Fixed panel actions leaving their destination hidden behind another tab in a grouped panel.
Prevented portability and Divi Library imports from uploading media without the required WordPress permission.
Fixed false save conflicts when staging websites rewrote image URLs in the Visual Builder.
Fixed component deletion leaving stale instances or removing their content after reloading the builder.
Fixed Timeline card and spacer layout gaps being ignored when using inherited layout settings.
Fixed a Builder crash when adding Text modules with the 360° Product Rotation plugin active.
Fixed apostrophes in custom attribute values being saved and displayed as HTML entity text.
Fixed Social Media Follow icon-size changes that did not animate on hover or while sticky.
Fixed the Section Library Import dialog appearing below the Builder when adding a section at the end of a page.
Fixed animations from imported module presets and saved animation overrides being lost during preset cleanup.
Fixed the Before/After Image slider losing its second image after moving the module in the Visual Builder.
Fixed Call To Action buttons ignoring the icon selected in a Button group preset.
Fixed Preset Manager moving below other sidebar panels after closing preset editing.
Fixed large Timeline marker icons overlapping adjacent content.
Fixed the Build With AI page creation flow failing to open when creating a new page.
Fixed off-canvas content disappearing when switching responsive previews in the Visual Builder.
Fixed module links so keyboard users could focus and open them with Enter.
Fixed button backgrounds disappearing when gradient text effects were applied.
Fixed an issue where a user without Theme Builder access could list, open, and change live header, body, and footer layouts from the Visual Builder.
Fixed background preset gradient colors displaying incorrectly in the gradient picker.
Improved global variable selection by showing full names on hover.
Fixed a Visual Builder error when changing the Menu module's Menu Style to Centered.
Fixed an issue where an Image module overlay set in an element preset did not appear in the Visual Builder or on the front end.
Fixed loop and dynamic excerpts exposing password-protected post content before the password was supplied.
Fixed the AI Agent prompt text becoming hard to read in Dark Mode while the field is focused.
Fixed orphaned Slot modules remaining on pages after detaching Components, while preserving their content and styling.
Fixed Body Text color overrides for Accordion and Toggle when a default preset was active.
Fixed nested tooltip text collapsing when its small parent used a centered absolute offset origin.
Fixed the Filterable Portfolio pagination class spelling while preserving existing custom CSS compatibility.
Fixed preset section dividers using incorrect neighboring background colors in the Visual Builder.
Fixed option-group preset interactions that failed on the frontend after saving.
Fixed Group Carousel layouts breaking when shown by an interaction.
Fixed JSON imports failing with a PHP memory error when the site's upload size limit exceeded available memory.
Fixed category descriptions appearing empty when editing archive pages with Theme Builder in Visual Builder.
Fixed global color references and filtered colors displaying incorrectly in the Theme Customizer.
Fixed unnecessary loading of MultiView and Waypoints scripts while preserving responsive content, animations, counters, and background video behavior.
Fixed a blank screen when exiting Theme Builder on sites using Google reCAPTCHA.
Fixed a flash of incorrect frontend styles caused by global CSS variables loading after page content.
Fixed persistent Background group and Gradient/Pattern/Mask field indicators after removing background effects.
Fixed Image module Force Fullwidth ignoring Tablet and Phone overrides when enabled on Desktop.
Improved page-loading performance when multiple modules shared the same presets.
Fixed grid items overlapping following items when expanded across additional columns in the Grid Editor.
Fixed Contact Form 7 Styler submit button alignment and its spacing consistency between the Visual Builder and the frontend.
Fixed the Add To Cart module not rendering when Current Product was selected in the Shop page Visual Builder.
Fixed Divi AI layout generation failing when the current page's HTML context exceeded the supported size limit.
Fixed missing gradient variable names in module settings when inherited from module or background presets.
Fixed Gallery column presets not rendering or inheriting correctly across responsive sizes.
Fixed Timeline Card background defaults and card sizing when Item alignment is set to Start.
Fixed deprecated jQuery resize event bindings during Visual Builder initialization while preserving responsive module behavior.
Fixed Accordion item transform transitions when hover borders are configured on the parent Accordion.
Fixed selecting and applying interaction presets when targeting parent containers, root containers, or children.
Added collaborative Notes to the Visual Builder with element-linked conversations, assignments, mentions, labels, notifications, and AI-assisted task resolution.
Fixed non-builder post content being altered during Divi 5 migration.
Fixed local desktop heading values not appearing in tablet and phone settings when element presets were active.
Fixed Loop Builder search results missing matches when search terms contain quotes, apostrophes, or ampersands.
Fixed SVG module hover fill and stroke colors so they apply to the entire SVG.
Fixed Contact Form fields closing click-triggered Tooltips when users tried to enter text.
Fixed interactions reappearing or duplicating when removed from elements using presets.
Fixed default Scroll Effects option group presets losing motion settings in the Visual Builder and frontend.
Fixed unrelated global canvases appearing in saved library item live previews.
Fixed referenced archived global variables being omitted from Theme Builder 404 pages.
Fixed responsive Video modules losing their aspect ratio or restarting after orientation changes.
Fixed unnecessary Spotify embed requests when Blog listings displayed standard posts with custom excerpts.
Fixed chart legend label text alignment in the Visual Builder and frontend.
Fixed default row presets overriding local width with header canvas interactions and inline styles.
Fixed selecting a Menu preset logo unexpectedly closing preset editing.
Updated Component and Library save dialogs to focus the name field automatically.
Fixed gradient directions using Number variables in the Builder and on the frontend.
Fixed Theme Builder template editing so added modules and deleted sections update correctly in the Visual Builder.
Fixed the module picker showing no modules after reopening a saved off-canvas.
Dynamic content settings will now open automatically if the dynamic content has unique settings that often need to be configured.
Fixed Visual Builder showing a blank layout when a Divi-built page is assigned as the WooCommerce shop page.
Fixed an issue where a user who can edit posts could publish a Theme Builder layout from the Visual Builder and replace the site's global header, footer, and body.
Fixed pages containing only components not appearing in “Your Existing Pages” when cloning a layout.
Fixed an issue where theme Additional CSS could load a second stylesheet that skipped Theme Builder layout styles.
Fixed the Right Margin and Padding fields so they match the width of the other spacing fields.
Fixed adding rows to new Section layouts in the Divi Library.
Fixed missing, stretched, and unplayable videos inside Group Carousel modules.
Fixed inherited preset number variables appearing active in margin and padding settings.
Fixed local heading underline styles failing to override Element and option-group presets.
Fixed responsive images using stale source-image metadata for unsynced Image fields inside component instances.
Fixed nested Icon modules inheriting their parent’s icon font and styling.
Fixed WooCommerce sale badges appearing above Global Header mobile menu dropdowns.
Fixed nested text colors differing between the Visual Builder and front end inside linked Icon modules.
Added a third-party registration hook after the AI Agent store is ready.
Fixed PHP test-harness compatibility across PHP 8.0–8.5.
Reduced memory usage and improved reliability of the Visual Builder type-check
Fixed background images disappearing when a global gradient was placed above them.
Fixed a fatal error when Theme Builder templates displayed ACF custom fields unavailable on the current post.
Added support for nesting number variables inside other number variables and CSS functions such as calc(), clamp(), min(), and max().
Added variable math in supported number fields, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
Added support for composing text variables from other text variables and static text.
Added support for combining multiple text variables, dynamic content sources, and static text in ordinary and rich-text fields.
Added individually editable chips for each variable or dynamic content source within a field.
Added support for replacing, removing, or detaching individual chips without changing surrounding content.
Added drag-and-drop reordering of chips within ordinary inline fields.
Added support for inserting variables at the cursor and replacing selected text with a variable or dynamic content source.
Added a {{ keyboard shortcut to open the variable picker in supported text, URL, and CSS number fields.
Added readable nested-variable previews and tooltips.
Enhanced variable search to match referenced variable names within composed values.
Enhanced variable exports to include all directly and indirectly referenced variable dependencies.
Enhanced Loop Builder content handling to preserve combinations of dynamic sources, variables, and static text.
Improved variable-chip inheritance across responsive breakpoints and hover and sticky states.
Added warnings for variable compositions that exceed resolution limits.
Fixed an issue where a custom HTML event handler saved in a global preset could appear on modules that did not have that handler.
Fixed a permission issue that allowed users to change, copy, or delete AI commands saved by someone else.
Fixed product images appearing twice in shop loops when using WooCommerce image-swap plugins.
Fixed ACF Options Page custom fields not displaying on the frontend when used with Dynamic Content in Divi 5.
Fixed Video module fullscreen mode breaking on Android when a different video was set for phone breakpoints, because responsive MultiView updates were resetting the player on resize.
Fixed an issue where a user who can edit posts could add, rename, or delete Divi Library categories and tags.
Fixed the Inspector showing text style controls instead of box shadow presets when editing box shadow on a module.
Fixed a security issue that let Contributors change the site's default color palette.
Fixed an issue where password-protected content could be copied into another post by a user who did not know the password.
Fixed the Grid Editor remaining open after saving or closing preset settings.
Fixed a security issue where the Divi 5 Migrator could be used to convert or roll back posts a user didn't have permission to edit.
Fixed a permission issue that allowed visitors to view published Divi Library layouts that are not intended to be publicly accessible.
Fixed a stored XSS vulnerability where HTML saved in a Tabs module's tab titles was rendered unescaped in the tab navigation.

Fixed an issue where Group Carousel clone and off-screen slides could still receive keyboard focus while hidden from screen readers, causing accessibility audit failures and incorrect link activation.
Fixed catalog-hidden WooCommerce products appearing in Loop Builder results.
Fixed Theme Customizer background color realtime preview and published output on Latest Posts home and Gutenberg pages.
Fixed background videos in Tabs so they size correctly when the tab first becomes visible.
Fixed SVG Image modules ignoring preset width settings in the Visual Builder and front end.
Fixed Blurb image and icon placement from newly created or updated option group presets in the Visual Builder.
Fixed Contact Form grid settings applying the column layout twice and shrinking the form fields.
Fixed bare paragraph tags disappearing while typing in the Text module's Text editor.
Fixed Theme Builder post layouts breaking when reloading a stale Visual Builder URL after switching the post to Gutenberg.
Fixed translated Divi Library import/export buttons overlapping the export checkbox.
Added regression coverage for WooCommerce looped price decimal formatting.
Fixed sticky-state custom CSS for Menu and Fullwidth Menu modules inside sticky parent elements.
Fixed misaligned attribute field controls when editing Components.
Fixed Contact Form layouts showing backwards compatibility mode after Divi 5 migration.
Fixed Filterable Portfolio custom CSS for filters, active filters, images, and post metadata.
Fixed sticky standard posts appearing in Blog modules displaying custom post type archives.
Fixed dynamic content failing to render ACF fields whose names begin with an underscore.
Fixed Text modules becoming uneditable after saving and reopening an embedded Theme Builder layout.
Fixed Post Slider featured backgrounds not filling a custom minimum height.
Fixed imported legacy layout presets losing their styles during conversion.
Fixed Menu module front-end font size ignoring Theme Customizer body text size when no custom menu font size was set.
Fixed copying an option group preset between compatible groups with different attribute paths.
Fixed imported option group presets losing their assignments on modules.
Fixed the Custom CSS color picker becoming unresponsive or losing color updates after repeated selections.
Fixed Divider line centering and the extra gap below bottom-aligned lines.
Fixed an enabled Save action inside newly added Component Slots that could freeze the Visual Builder.
Fixed Pagination's WP-PageNavi current-page label using different box geometry from numbered links.
Fixed the Choose Files button dropping below the filename field in Divi import dialogs.
Improved AI Agent token efficiency for page content reviews and storytelling suggestions by making compact text discovery available automatically.
Fixed appended global canvases disappearing when SEO plugins generated automatic excerpts before rendering the page.
Fixed Post Filter select placeholders so ACF field labels display correctly for logged-out visitors.
Fixed appended canvas visibility styles hiding Theme Builder headers on archive pages.
Fixed Slider automatic animation timing after hover and browser visibility changes.
Fixed the missing Gradient Position control for Conical gradients in the Gradient Picker.
Fixed Blog element preset pagination text colors not appearing in the Visual Builder.
Fixed fixed-position canvas content leaking over Canvas Grid previews after reopening a Theme Builder header.
Fixed keyboard navigation resetting the selected editing state when switching between module settings.
Fixed Divi AI Agent login when the WordPress Site Title is longer than 255 characters.
Fixed an issue where Theme Customizer button text and border color pickers reset to white instead of the theme primary accent color.
Fixed draggable items escaping the Visual Builder left-panel content area when moved horizontally.

Fixed background blend mode not working when parallax effect is enabled with background image and color or gradient. The blend mode now correctly applies to the parallax background element in both Visual Builder and frontend, and the background image and blend mode are properly rendered on the wrapper element for mobile device support.
Added an Icon Manager with custom SVG and icon-font imports, reusable collections, collection import/export, an updated icon picker, and AI-assisted icon management.
Added a new icon picker field that makes it easy to pick icons from different icon collections, along with quick access to the icon manager.
Updated Divi's native icons with WOFF2 support.
Fixed some bugs with extending, copying, and pasting icon field attributes between different types of modules.
Fixed an issue where editing structure inside a global element could still show unsaved changes or a browser backup prompt after auto-save and page reload.
Fixed the AI Agent Build dropdown and nearby controls disappearing when the chat panel is narrowed.
Fixed the SVG Module not switching to the Sticky-state graphic when the module became sticky.
Fixed Visual Builder save failing on The Events Calendar Pro recurring events.
Fixed Section and Row appearing in lowercase in Layers view after converting Block Editor content to the Divi Builder.
Fixed an issue where a long AI Agent queue could hide the chat and the message input.
Fixed Gallery grid images appearing too small on tablet and phone when page gutter width was set to 1.
Fixed right-click pasting is disabled into the AI Agent chat prompt field.
Fixed AI Agent bulk changes to existing Layout Style settings.
Fixed option group preset changes not updating module settings immediately after saving the preset in the Visual Builder.
Fixed Classic Editor builder controls to respect Divi role permissions.
Fixed incorrect empty space above or below some Vimeo videos in the Video module caused by fluid video wrapper padding.
Fixed preset names being incorrectly changed during layout import.
Fixed Divi AI preset and module-attribute tools to reject invalid writes and protect module labels.
Improved AI Agent image audits and optional optimization using appropriately sized Media Library variants.
Improved the AI Agent so converting repeated page styles into presets happens in one step.
Fixed an issue where WooCommerce Add To Cart button spacing was ignored when the button icon was disabled.
Fixed Visual Builder design fields showing hover numeric values in desktop inputs after entering only spaces on desktop for typography and other CSS length options.
Improve Divi 5 PHP test runtime and retain verifiable full-suite/sharded coverage equivalence.
Improved Divi 5 PHP test runtime so local and CI suites complete faster without changing product behavior.
Fixed Visual Builder action tooltips appearing away from their controls when the builder canvas was scaled on smaller screens.
Fixed an issue where a person module had extra spacing on the Visual Builder and not on the front-end.
Fixed unsafe custom attributes being applied or restored by preset interactions.
Fixed an issue where a user who can edit posts but cannot publish could publish content through the Page Manager.
Fixed Theme Options Library so only users who can edit Theme Options can save presets to the local library.
Fixed an issue where importing a Divi Library file could create categories the user is not allowed to manage.
Fixed a brief freeze in the Visual Builder when editing large layouts.
Fixed Instagram account action buttons losing labels, changing width, or displaying oversized loading indicators during requests.
Fixed animated, absolutely positioned Theme Builder sections disappearing in Tablet and Phone editing views.
Restored Button Option Group preset spacing on standalone Button modules.
Fixed Post Filter category and other hierarchical taxonomy field options displaying as a flat list instead of preserving parent and child structure.
Improved AI Agent text contrast and size updates so page-wide readability edits use far fewer tokens.
Fixed WooCommerce popularity sorting in Post Filter product loops.
Fixed a Visual Builder issue where the main Exit action could redirect to `/wp-admin` when browser referrer headers were disabled.
Fixed fluid variable previews displaying endpoint values under the wrong Clamp Min and Clamp Max columns.
Fixed Person module Title custom CSS not migrating from Divi 4.
Improved Divi AI agent efficiency by keeping only the latest matching module-type inventory in later AI requests.
Fixed migrated Divi 4 Text Modules so their alignment can be changed in Divi 5.
Fixed Tab child parallax backgrounds jumping to an incorrect position when first displayed.
Added a Collapsible Mobile Menu option to the Menu module so nested mobile submenus can expand and collapse without custom code.
Fixed Tabs content remaining closed on initial load inside duplicated Group Carousel slides.
Fixed Gallery pagination failing to scroll back to the gallery when changing pages.
Fixed deleting the second or later account from the Instagram Feed account context menu.
Fixed Tabs module backgrounds not filling the configured module height.
Improved Divi AI token usage when making page elements use the same preset.
Fixed a bug where pressing Cmd+Shift to multi-select didn't work correctly when you were already hovering over the element you wanted to select.
Added the ability to multi-select individual modules using Cmd+click.
The right-click menu now works with multi-selected elements, allowing you to add, delete, duplicate, cut, copy, paste, reset, lock, and move multiple elements at once.
Fixed incorrect undo keyboard shortcut label in the right-click menu.
Added bulk editing support for multi-selected elements, allowing users to edit multiple elements at once in the settings panel.
The Inspector now supports selecting multiple elements, allowing you to inspect and perform bulk operations on multiple elements at once.
The AI Agent now supports scoping for multiple selected elements.
The layers panel now supports multi-selection and drag-and-drop for multi-selected elements.
Added searching support to the keyboard shortcuts panel.
Added missing keyboard shortcuts to the keyboard shortcuts panel.
Button options will now show inherited values using a gray border, differentiating them from explicit values, which are blue.
Checkbox options will show inherited values as gray check boxes, differentiating them from explicit values, which are blue.
Improved the performance of working with Title and Body text options.
Improved AI Agent image replacements so page-wide placeholder and semantic photo updates use far fewer tokens.
Fixed the Divi Builder button appearing for users without permission to toggle the Divi Builder.
Fixed inline SVG stroke colors and widths not rendering in the SVG and Code modules.
Fixed Divi 4 Video play-icon hover CSS applying when hovering the whole module after migration.

Fixed enabling the Divi Builder on the WooCommerce Shop page when the Classic Editor is enabled.

Fixed Contact Form submissions allowing line breaks from submitted name or email values to reach mail headers.

Fixed Price Range fields overflowing narrow Post Filter module containers.
Fixed the Bar Counters fill animation so it plays smoothly after reloading Visual Builder.
Fixed Blurb Layout justify content and related flex alignment options not applying when the module had min-height or height, including with left or right icon placement.

Fixed Divi AI Agent not applying Fade, Blur, Rotate, Horizontal Motion, and Scaling scroll effects.
ePanel custom keywords no longer log an undefined `$postid` warning on no-post requests such as 404 and empty-search pages.

Fixed nested Group modules inside a Group Carousel slide incorrectly labeled as “Carousel Slide” in the Visual Builder Layers panel.
Fixed WooCommerce product images disappearing after automatic Post Filter updates.
Fixed Transform Skew errors in hover and responsive editing when the desktop value was blank.

Fixed the WooCommerce Return to Shop button shifting when hovered.
Fixed Tooltip so an open tooltip stays with its target when scrolling instead of sticking to the bottom of the screen.
Fixed global module instances and selective-sync descriptors not migrating legacy form field focus styling paths.
Reduced duplicate Dynamic Content options requests when editing modules with many dynamic fields.
Fixed the Post Filter module showing a select dropdown arrow on mobile when the field type was set to checkbox (or another non-select type) for that breakpoint.
Added safeguards to avoid variable data loss in the event of an unforeseen future bug leading to incorrect variable array merging.
Global modules are now components, including a host of new functionality.
Improved performance of editing sub elements within a parent component, ensuring the save operation does not cause re-renders that slow down module adding/deleting/duplicating.
Added a new method for converting static modules into existing components, mapping static attributes to matching unsynced attributes within the component.
Components now support select sync on nested module attributes.
Introduced a new component editing mode, which separates the editing of local and global component attributes.
Fixed a bug where multiple instances of the same component could get out of sync when moving modules nested within the parent component.
Added the new Slot module, which can be used inside component to create slots of local-instanced modules within the global component.
Saving confirmation is no longer required when navigating between different nested modules within the same parent component.
Presets can now be applied on the local instance on top of presets moused within components.
The selective sync icon for components was moved from the left of fields into the existing field label icon group for consistency.
Fixed a bug where the back button didn't display properly when editing a module within an unsynced elements group within a component.

Fixed dragging nested modules out of a component and then back into a duplicate instance of the original component; now that removable/addition from and to the same parent module acts as a module move within the parent component.
Detached global module attributes now inherit default values from the parent component.
Components now import and export with layouts similar to presets and variables.
Added dedicated components importer and exporter.
Added new components manager and editor panels, allowing you to edit, delete and duplicate components in the visual builder instead of having to visit the Divi library.
Nested modules within components can now be completely detached and worked with at the instance level within a parent component.
Improved performance of resizing and moving undocked panels.
Components can now have other components nested inside them (for example, a section component supports addition module components within it).
Fixed components rendering in the wrong order in wireframe view when wireframe view was set as the default workspace view mode.
Fixed broken components when imported via attached theme builder layouts.
Added new AI Agent tool for deleting and duplicating components.
Added new AI Agent tool for converting modules to existing components.
Added new AI Agent tool for saving modules as components.
Added new AI Agent tool for updating component attributes.
Fixed an issue where Loop Builder meta queries using Field Exists (EXISTS) did not filter posts correctly in the Visual Builder when the meta value was left empty.
Fixed AI Agent removing before and after text from dynamic content in Text Modules when generated layouts used dynamic dates or years.
Fixed Divi AI nested submenu options not lining up with the parent item when the WordPress admin bar was enabled in Visual Builder.
Fixed ConvertKit (Kit) Email Optin not showing account custom fields after Fetch Lists when Kit Settings defined subscriber custom fields.

Fixed multiple Components issues including incorrect frontend rendering for nested Components, stale selective-sync values on the frontend, broken Cancel when editing nested Component sources, invalid drag-and-drop across Slots and synchronized structure, and prevention of self-referencing Component saves.
Fixed Button module left-aligned custom icons so they no longer overlap the text when a hover icon color is set.
Fixed canvas images whose filenames contain a `u` followed by four hexadecimal characters.
Fixed Post Carousel Carousel Item Title Text composable settings applying to the module wrapper instead of the item title.
Fixed Blog module Read More link text on the frontend so it matches the Visual Builder preview when Show Read More Button is enabled.
Fixed Call to Action unordered-list styles not being preserved during Divi 4 to Divi 5 migration.
Fixed frontend Module Elements custom CSS output for Post Filter and Post Filter Item modules.
Fixed Tab module child parallax background images so they display immediately when switching tabs.
Fixed Loop Builder excerpts so HTML and line breaks render on the live page when Number of Words is set.
Fixed Row sticky background colors not rendering in the Visual Builder when the Row is inside a sticky Section.
Fixed frontend styles breaking on a layout when a spacing value contained an invalid character.
Fixed the Map module address field not clearing its visible text immediately after reset when a location had been found with the Find button.
Fixed an issue where a custom z-index was ignored while an element was sticky, so sticky elements could not stack in the configured order.
Fixed missing global color names in module settings after the AI Agent converts repeated colors into global variables.
Fixed an issue where the Divi Library save action could overwrite a post the current user is not allowed to edit.
Fixed Visual Builder crash in the Portfolio module when Post Count contained a space.
Fixed automatic Post Filter options for ACF choice fields to display configured choice labels instead of stored values.
Fixed wrong button icon with uppercase text enabled.
Fixed Background Patterns and Masks not rendering when applied from an Element Preset or a Background Option Group Preset.
Fixed Instagram Feed modules being limited to 24 posts.
Fixed importing certain pages and layouts from the library not working in the builder.
Fixed a Divi Cloud build failure caused by conflicting Common Sass module variables.
Fixed an issue where AI Agent checkpoint sync could silently lose rejected batch items after a page reload instead of retrying them or surfacing a sync error.

The Visual Builder now uses CSS-contract default breakpoint mins in visual-builder/packages/app-ui/src/store/states/index.ts (desktop 1025, tabletWide 981, tablet 861, phoneWide 768), derives zoom from the target breakpoint band, keeps page-bar width updates tied to the largest enabled breakpoint, and keeps selected desktop plus larger fluid breakpoints inside the correct styling band.
Builder Settings, command-based view changes, and add-module modal positioning now follow the same corrected fluid breakpoint sizing model.
Added icon/image alignment option in Blurb module.
Fixed Background Gradient settings modal being cut off on small viewports or high browser zoom, so the picker now resizes to fit the screen and scrolls when needed.
Added dedicated Theme Builder migration test coverage for D4-to-D5 layout conversion.
Fixed duplicate Target Module dropdown entries when editing TB layouts and duplicate global canvas rendering when a canvas is both appended and targeted by an interaction.
Fixed page off-canvas canvases rendering in the wrong position and breaking Theme Builder header preset styles when append-below canvases were used alongside a TB header.
Internal test coverage only; no customer-facing changelog.

Added comprehensive third-party module test fixtures and snapshots (L1–L5) for Divi 5 third-party module registration, conversion, rendering, presets, dynamic content, and custom modal coverage. Fixed D4→D5 conversion module-discovery cache so third-party modules registered after the first conversion pass convert to native D5 blocks instead of falling back to shortcode-module.
Fixed Place Order button background color not applying in Theme Builder Visual Builder for the Woo Checkout Payment module.
Body text lists now keep nested unordered-list markers when a parent ordered list uses a custom ordered style.
Breadcrumbs on Theme Builder author archive templates now show a plain author name instead of a literal <span> tag.
Fixed Theme Builder layout IDs failing to resolve during Visual Builder settings bootstrap on REST requests when the current request context had no template assignments.
Added tests for dynamic content and fixed the Post Title module showing the wrong title and the author archive dynamic titles showing the wrong post's author.
Fixed an issue where Theme Builder Visual Builder loops using the Current Page query type could display one more post than the Posts Per Page setting.
Fixed Portfolio Current Category filtering on Project Category archive pages when projects belong to multiple categories.
Fixed a front-end fatal error when Icon List icon size used a complex size value in Theme Builder layouts.
Fixed a front-end fatal error when a Menu module logo URL was stored as a complex value instead of a string.
Fixed a Visual Builder regression where legacy button option-group presets could still show icons on hover when preset icon visibility was disabled.
Fixed variation swatches showing the same images for every product when wishlist or compare plugins were active on Theme Builder product category templates.
Fixed Theme Builder search header layout breaking when the first search result was a Divi Builder custom post type.
Fixed Tooltip modules closed via Interactions so they can be reopened by clicking the trigger again.
Fixed Tooltip modules so open tooltip content paints above later page modules instead of being covered by them.
Fixed a frontend fatal error that could occur when border radius was stored as a simple value instead of the expected corner settings.
Fixed Theme Builder History entries that appeared blank when removing header or footer template parts.
Fixed an issue where background color opacity changes on hover were not saved when the desktop color had 0% opacity.
Added the Post Filter and Post Filter Item modules, giving site visitors a configurable filter form that refines Divi Loop Builder results in real time through bookmarkable URL parameters.
Security Update: Fixed a stored XSS risk in Social Media Follow Skype URL handling by applying consistent URL escaping at render time. Props to Sico.eX for the responsible disclosure.
Added new Grid Editor, enabling the visual creation of advanced grid layouts.
Added support for number variables in the grid offset editor.
Individual grid offset editor rules now support the full range of start, end, and span settings in a single rule.
Fixed columns getting consolidated when switching the layout style from flex to grid when editing a row preset.
Fixed grid offset rules not being copied to presets when creating new presets from current styles.
Fixed minimum column width CSS not printing when set at the module level, when "equal minimum width columns" was set at the preset level.
Fixed sections remaining hidden when section animation was enabled but duration and delay were stored as empty values.
Fixed Theme Builder loops using the “current page” query on 404 pages incorrectly showing recent blog posts instead of the no-results state.
Fixed Button Line Color and Button Line Style being unavailable when editing hover or sticky states after enabling underline on the normal state.
Improved frontend font-family sanitization and archived global variable CSS output reliability.
WooCommerce checkout pages built with Divi checkout modules now render one consistent checkout form instead of multiple competing checkout forms.
Woo Product Gallery now exposes Design -> Image -> Sizing -> Column Class and keeps wrapped flex gallery item sizing aligned between the frontend and Visual Builder.
Fixed an issue where nested Blurb modules could display the wrong icon in Visual Builder preview due to parent icon style leakage.
Fixed ACF Color Picker dynamic content not displaying the correct text and decoration colors in the Visual Builder, so on-canvas styles now match the resolved colors shown on the live site.
Internal test coverage only; no customer-facing changelog.
Added Theme Builder Playwright smoke tests to the Builder 5 CI pipeline.
Added a Playwright smoke test that verified the Theme Builder admin screen loads.
Fixed the Layer view drop zone indicator and drag handle label being invisible in dark mode when dragging regular modules.
Fixed an issue where module settings reset/default values could show module preset styles instead of the applied option group preset styles.
Fixed an issue where custom button icons did not appear on the Contact Form 7 Styler module submit button in the Visual Builder and on the front end.
Fixed Dropdown mega-menu positioning and sizing so floating menus can reliably align to parent row or viewport width across columns.
Fixed frontend module order classes not starting at zero after layout migration.
Imported legacy Text modules now preserve the expected Open Sans body weight during import so frontend rendering matches freshly created Text modules.
Fixed an issue where Code Module curly-quote HTML entities rendered correctly in Visual Builder but not on the frontend.
Fixed an issue where CTA modules with AnalyticsWP tracking enabled could enter backward compatibility mode after Divi 4 to Divi 5 migration.
Fixed Visual Builder REST responses exposing Instagram tokens and accepting invalid Post Navigation post contexts.
Improved performance of variable font weight inheritance.
Fixed an issue where Video modules could fail to render YouTube videos when a video is added via Insert from URL in the media modal.
Added more Google fonts to the default list of web fonts.
Added support for flexible fonts, including variable font weight and many additional font settings.
Added a drop cap tab to all body text option groups, allowing drop caps to be added and styled along with paragraph, anchor text, block quote and lists.
Add new text styling options too all body font elements, including text direction, columns, stroke position, capitalization, hyphenation and wrapping.
The long font select menu is now lazy loaded, improving performance when selecting fonts.
Fixed Comment Module comment boxes duplicating in the Visual Builder when changing Comment Count or Form Title heading levels.
Fixed a fatal error when using Event Tickets Move Attendees and other admin iframe flows that pass a null hook suffix to admin_enqueue_scripts.
Fixed Divi 4 to Divi 5 migration for mixed Gutenberg and Divi Layout content by improving layout block detection and preserving non-layout Gutenberg blocks with native serialization.
Fixed accordion modules showing backward compatibility mode after D5 migration when Rank Math FAQ Schema Markup was enabled in Divi 4.
Fixed Group Carousel in the Visual Builder not navigating to a newly added carousel slide, which prevented adding content to the new slide without manually switching slides.
Fixed an issue where Brevo/Sendinblue custom fields were not always visible in the Email Optin module Visual Builder.
Fixed an issue where the field dropdown always showed "Choose a field..." after selection.
Fixed an issue where custom fields remained visible on the canvas after disabling the "Use Custom Fields" toggle.
Fixed global font variables not rendering in the Visual Builder when applied to module font settings.
Fixed Query Monitor reporting missing dependencies for wp-block-library on Theme Builder pages with header or footer overrides when Defer Block CSS is enabled.
Fixed gap-0 global variables not appearing in Dynamic Content pickers for dimensional number fields such as Horizontal Gap.
Fixed Preview Mode showing disabled modules at 50% opacity when the "Show Disabled Modules At 50% Opacity" builder setting was enabled.
Fixed Google+ icon appearing in the Person module on imported layouts when no Google+ setting is available.

Fixed nested module entrance animations not playing inside the Dropdown module when editing in the Visual Builder, so animated content inside an open dropdown now matches the behavior on the live page.
Improved Divi 5 AI Agent planner prompt clarity and orchestration consistency for multi-agent request execution.
Fixed default Layout option group preset Vertical Gap not applying to columns on the frontend when the preset was not explicitly assigned.
Fixed an issue where the default image border could not be removed from Woo Related Products using the builder's Image border settings.
Fixed a Blog migration issue where the D4 "Show Content" option could revert to excerpt behavior after conversion to Divi 5.
Fixed Visual Builder crash when loop subTypes were stored as an object instead of an array, which caused nested modules such as Group Carousel and Icon List to show "Oops, an error has occurred".
Added public upload attachment metadata support for third-party developers, including attachmentMetadata on upload field change events and a getAttachmentMetadata() helper in @divi/field-library.

Fixed CSS numeric and similar module settings fields losing their value when edited in the main settings modal by correctly handling field onChange callbacks that pass a plain value instead of an event-shaped object.

Adds Layer 1 preset unit tests for Divi 5: a shared cross-cutting fixture library, then PHP and TypeScript coverage for stack normalization, preset merge and selection, option-group discovery and attribute path mapping, attribute fetch and merge primitives, full merge orchestration (including two small production fixes), preset class names and store selectors, edit-mode field resolution, and edit-container plus settings-panel orchestrator merge paths (with a behavior-neutral settings merge extract for unit testability).
Fixed Blurb image alignment not applying when image width used a percentage unit with top image placement.
Fixed Group Carousel automatic rotation not working in the Visual Builder while it worked correctly on the frontend.
Fixed modifier indicator dot appearing on border option groups when explicit border values matched defaults.
Fixed Block Row layouts breaking on the frontend after updating Divi when Website Gutter Width was customized.
Fixed a migration regression where column widths could become larger after update due to gutter class and dynamic asset desynchronization.
Fixed an issue where Countdown Timer, Email Optin, and Login could lose frontend padding because et_pb_no_bg was incorrectly added when non-color backgrounds were active.
Fixed an issue where migrated modules could receive unintended center auto margins when module alignment was set to center without custom width constraints.

Fixed an issue where the CSS Variable option was incorrectly shown in the color type picker for Background Pattern Color and Background Mask Color fields, causing those fields to render as black when a CSS variable was selected.
Fixed the Contact Form Module failing to submit or show a success message when All-In-One SEO was active.

Fixed an issue where clicking "Remove Variable" on a global color in a background gradient stop would leave the stop's color empty, causing the gradient to break and the background to appear white after saving and refreshing the page.
Added Tooltip module.
Fixed an issue where WordPress automatic update scrape requests could regenerate incomplete Divi 5 homepage CSS, causing builder styles to disappear.
Fixed an issue where pages visited with specific URL paramaters could generate invalid CSS for pages containing loops.
Fixed VB perf regression by removing update-transient priming from perf-mode bootstrap and restored CI perf gate thresholds.
Fixed an issue where a thin sliver of the next Group Carousel slide could show at certain viewport widths.
D4 Search migration now keeps Search native and moves the legacy free-form CSS rule into module free-form CSS instead of leaving it at the page level.
Fixed an issue where saving a page in the Visual Builder could purge all LiteSpeed Cache entries instead of only the edited page.
Fixed Button Options selection and global module sync tracking edge cases by aligning field change payload typing and handling immutable attribute trees correctly.
Fixed an issue where Section Area Background Color could fail to apply in certain Theme Builder front-end layouts, causing sections to appear white.
Fixed false CSS linter errors when using nested selectors without & in Free Form CSS and other Divi 5 CodeMirror CSS fields.
Fixed Image module lightbox not opening inside Group Carousel after the carousel looped back to the first slide.
Fixed workspace save not preserving the selected sidebar tab when multiple tabs are open in the same row.

Fixed default Heading/Body global font variable labels, aligned VB/FE font resolution using shared/customizer store data, and resolved frontend fallback issues for default-like customizer font values.
Fixed Contact Form 7 Styler button icon and rounded corners on hover.
Fixed control layering in the Slider Module so arrows and dot navigation stay above high z-index Slide content.
Fixed heading level set through Option Group or module presets not applying to rendered HTML on the frontend and Visual Builder.
Fixed an issue where the Pagination module did not display custom Previous link text on hover.
Fixed an issue where input fields could stop responding after saving the Visual Builder.
Fixed an issue where the top-bar Clear Layout modal would not reopen after being closed.
Fixed Social Media Follow icon font size and icon color being unavailable for editing in the sticky state.
Fixed an issue where Divi Cloud duplicate and copy actions could save empty layout content to the cloud when a layout failed to download or export correctly.
Fixed an issue where Theme Customizer background settings could reset after activating a child theme.
Preserved the parent theme background color and image when activating a child theme.
Fixed a PHP deprecated warning when using custom CSS on the Contact Form module's Contact Button field.
Fixed an issue where the Layers panel could unexpectedly jump when activating modules that were already visible or when selecting modules directly inside Layers.
Added new workspace management system, allowing users to create customizable workspaces that encapsulate default builder settings and modal positioning.
Added new command center comments for switching workspaces and updating existing workspaces.
Auto-closing panels will no longer auto-close when docked.
Fixed an issue where third-party shortcode modules could remain in backward compatibility mode in Divi 5 when content did not include a core Divi shortcode token.
Fixed "create preset from current styles" not capturing nested composite group attributes when creating a group preset.
Fixed dropdown panels jumping horizontally after entrance animation when dropdown alignment was set to center or end.
Fixed an issue where the Loop Element setting could incorrectly appear in the Modified Styles filter with a reset option after the loop was turned off.
Fixed Breadcrumbs modules so Justify Content works on newly inserted modules without toggling Layout Direction first.
Fixed saved layouts not loading in the Visual Builder library on hosts with strict MySQL join limits, and added a clear error when the library query still cannot run.
Added a Visual Builder filter so third-party extensions can append controls next to module field labels in the module settings modal, with documentation and a copy-paste example.
Fixed icons sitting at the top of button-options fields when options used icons without label text.
Fixed icon alignment in Visual Builder button-option controls so icon-only choices render vertically centered.
Fixed a thin section divider seam that could appear during load and responsive rendering in Divi 5.
Fixed an issue where group preset styles (including border radius) could fail to apply in the Visual Builder when preset class names were not attached correctly.

Fixed incorrect heading font sizes on the front-end and in the Visual Builder when Text modules use option group presets, by removing preset-duplicate values from module attributes during import and at render time so preset CSS is no longer overridden by module-level rules.
Fixed SVG module stroke width control so users can no longer set negative stroke widths.
Fixed the Layers View cursor freezing when dragging contact form fields (and other child modules) between modules after an invalid or blocked drop.
Fixed false save confirmation when using Layers More Options on a global element that had already been saved.
Fixed Theme Builder header sticky sections not sticking on scroll in the Visual Builder when editing a page.
Fixed Timeline item date, title, and body text not appearing on the live page when the Timeline card background image parallax effect was enabled.
Fixed an issue where Number Counter modules could switch to a default value on mobile tap when responsive hover values were not set.
Fixed a Button module hover-spacing regression where disabled icons could still reserve icon-like horizontal space when only one custom padding was set.
Fixed list item indent for ordered and unordered lists in Divi 5 on posts where theme sidebar styles overrode module padding.

Object Position responsive editing now shows the full focus-point UI and preview image on every supported responsive row in the Visual Builder, including custom wide breakpoints, and preview/spinner interactions switch the active breakpoint consistently.

Fixed Video module responsive overlay images not appearing on the frontend when the desktop overlay image was empty, including object-shaped responsive thumbnail payloads. Hardened server-side image source normalization to prevent Visual Builder loading failures from malformed/object-shaped image src values.
Fixed blank Layers panel labels for loop-enabled child modules when List Text (or equivalent title field) uses a loop dynamic content field such as Loop Post Title.
Fixed an issue where shortcode-backed URL fields in Divi 5 could render malformed links by standardizing URL normalization before sanitization across affected rendering paths.
Fixed invalid empty width and height CSS on the frontend after manually clearing sizing fields in the builder instead of using reset or the unit picker.
Fixed Sidebar Body Text design settings so paragraph text inside widgets now updates consistently in both Visual Builder and frontend output.
Fixed DeepHive companion PR handling so same-issue/same-branch dependency ordering feedback is treated as non-blocking without weakening true blocking review outcomes.
Fixed Toggle module grid column layout in the Visual Builder when changing layout while the toggle content is already open.
Fixed Social Follow network custom attributes so rel and other link attributes apply to the icon and follow button links instead of only the list item wrapper.
Fixed migrated background gradients rendering with incorrect length units by preserving and inferring gradient units.
Fixed migrated Text module heading font style conversion so empty heading styles keep inherited text casing instead of forcing reset casing.
Fixed interaction Target Module list not updating when new modules are added on an existing page until save or reload.
Fixed Search module Button Text font-weight not applying when Text Color was set to Light.
Fixed Divi 5 Image module alignment so migrated custom spacing margins are preserved while SVG alignment behavior remains intact.
Theme Customizer Body Font Weight now defaults to Regular and keeps the Customizer, frontend, and Visual Builder aligned when no custom weight is saved.
Updated Divi 5 extension-module documentation with dedicated tutorials for enabling and customizing Layout and HTML settings groups.
Fixed the Theme Builder “Load From Library” modal staying in light mode and showing hard-to-read tabs when the builder is set to Dark Mode.
Fixed console errors on the Theme Options and Divi Library admin pages when using WordPress 6.9 or later.
Added gradient variables.
Added a new gradient field component and a gradient picker panel.
Add new gradient and image text fill options to font groups.
Added a new "convert to variable" option to the field right-click menus.
Fixed gradient stop colors not being detected in the inspector.
Fixed image replacement in the inspector, replacing the image URL with an invalid object instead of the URL string.
Inherited variables are now shown with reduced opacity in the settings panel to make their inheritance clear.
Fixed inherited values in the responsive editor showing up as hard values instead of placeholder values in the field components.
Imported legacy Text modules now preserve the expected Open Sans body weight during import so frontend rendering matches freshly created Text modules.
Fixed HTML in dynamic content Before and After fields not rendering in the Link module on the Visual Builder and front end.
Fixed SVG Code being cleared when reloading the Visual Builder for Global SVG modules.
Fixed Icon List Item Body Text color not applying to hyperlinks inside list item text (including Loop Post Terms with taxonomy links).
Fixed off-canvas content being replaced with main canvas content when clicking the main canvas star in the Canvases dropdown while editing another canvas.
Fixed Loop Builder Order By options missing after reloading a Theme Builder template when Query Type was set to Posts For Current Page.
Fixed Testimonial portrait stacking in Divi 5 flex layouts by extending narrow-column detection to flex column classes on desktop and tablet.
Fixed Video module aspect ratio targeting so portrait YouTube embeds use the same sizing selector chain as existing video height constraints.
Fixed accordion content scrolling underneath sticky sections on the front end by including builder sticky element height in the accordion auto-scroll offset, matching anchor link scroll behavior.
Improved module-creation workflow guardrails so generated modules more reliably match approved implementation contracts.
Saved layouts no longer keep a desktop centering offset on tablet and phone when a module switches back to relative positioning at smaller breakpoints.
Fixed preset-based button hover padding regressions in CTA and related module paths where hover could incorrectly fall back to default hard-coded padding.

Added Module Elements documentation (Introduction, Render, Script Data, Style) under Module explanations, with full API parameter references, paired VB/FE usage examples, updated Module category sidebar order, and improved formatting conventions.
Prevented hide-on-load interactions from flashing on initial page load.
Fixed an issue where closing preset editing could close Preset Manager instead of returning users to it when editing was initiated from Preset Manager.
Fixed an issue where local Column padding in the Visual Builder did not apply when a module preset also defined padding, because preset padding was incorrectly marked as important.
Fixed a critical error on the front end when layouts stored object position as separate horizontal and vertical values instead of a single CSS value.
Fixed Blurb module title hover text not updating on the frontend when a Title Link URL is set.
Fixed an issue where Theme Builder pages could occasionally generate incomplete critical/deferred CSS after partial cache invalidation, causing missing frontend styles.
Link module Design → Layout now applies to nested modules because their output sits in the same .et_pb_link_inner flex container as the Link’s icon and text in both the frontend and Visual Builder.
Link grid layout now keeps the text row full-width so nested Icons can occupy the grid columns together instead of splitting across rows.
The Link inner wrapper now renders as a div so nested block-level module roots remain valid and do not get hoisted out of the Link subtree in the Visual Builder.

Link now suppresses nested Icon anchors under divi/link, resets default nested child-module bottom spacing inside .et_pb_link_inner, and ships an earlier FE flex baseline for .et_pb_link_inner through the existing Link static CSS path to avoid the observed load jump.

Updated the example extension modules so Layout, HTML, and Elements match core Divi 5 patterns in VB, extended the same behavior to Child Module with a documented inner layout pattern, aligned Parent with Accordion-style child rules, and fixed front-end render callbacks so Elements children and module styles output correctly.
Fixed third-party modules being unable to open settings panels.
Fixed premade layout library appearing empty when opening the load layout modal from the page creation flow.
Fixed Responsive Editor not showing preset values on the desktop row when opening the responsive editor from module level.
Fixed the missing browser backup restore prompt in the Divi 5 Visual Builder after a tab crash or reload when unsaved edits existed in the previous session.
Removed the legacy D4 frontend builder runtime while keeping required legacy build outputs intact.

Lockfile regenerations across the repo and related submodules are intentional and tied to removing Node 14-era dependencies and aligning the toolchain with Node 18/20 + Corepack/Yarn 4.7.0. These updates are required to keep installs/builds deterministic after the Node 14 removal.
Image modules using Grow to Fill with Cover now stretch to the full row height in Safari without changing the shared VB/frontend contract.

Fixed Visual Builder incorrectly reporting a failed save for some layouts where special characters and HTML-related module fields caused save verification to disagree with the real Divi save pipeline.
Image module border-radius clipping now works for complex radius values such as clamp(...), so rounded images clip correctly without custom CSS.
Fixed an issue where the Visual Builder could fully reload when using a Link module with a Dropdown module set to open on click, which could discard unsaved changes.
Fixed built-in icon picker showing incorrect icons when selecting icons in the Visual Builder on RTL sites.
Fixed an issue where the Icon module's background color stretched across the full column width instead of centering around the icon in flex layouts.
Fixed modules disappearing on the Visual Builder canvas when decoration animation repeat was set to loop, especially after hovering once the first animation cycle had finished.

Fixed frontend PHP fatal on some pages when image URL fields in saved content were not valid strings, so the page can load instead of crashing (invalid image data may no longer display until content is corrected).

Fixed Visual Builder saves (and related REST actions) failing after long idle when WordPress and Divi REST nonces went stale, by refreshing those nonces and retrying the request once, and by allowing fresh nonces to merge during after-app-load.

Introduced divi_remove_empty_array_attributes_pre_filter WordPress filter in ModuleUtils::remove_empty_array_attributes(), allowing third-party modules to preserve intentional empty array field values that would otherwise be removed during save-time security sanitization.
Fixed loop pages incorrectly inheriting CSS from Divi-built posts when auto-generated loop excerpts rendered those posts’ layouts in the background.
Fixed an issue where clicking the settings icon on a Link module in the Visual Builder could load the linked page inside the builder instead of opening module settings.
Fixed an issue where the Filter by Date field in the Visual Builder media library was misaligned after updating to WordPress 7.0.
Fixed AI Agent inserting blank modules and failing to edit unset attributes — the agent now adds modules with the requested content populated and can change any attribute on any module on first try.
Fixed Fullwidth Image background video not playing after migrating from Divi 4 when the module had a video background.
Fixed default heading font not applying in Theme Builder Visual Builder when heading text font is set to Default.
Fixed an issue where the Sizing option group incorrectly appeared as modified on newly added Columns in the Visual Builder.
Fixed Loop Builder Order and Order By not applying when using Posts for Current Page on archive templates.
Fixed global preset save failing with a validation error when module presets included stacked group preset metadata from the builder.
Fixed Blurb title overlapping an animated image on the front end so published pages match the Visual Builder when composable title styling overlaps the image.
Fixed Post Slider background overlay tint not applying in the Visual Builder when Dark text color was set on phone only while desktop or tablet remained Light.

Fixed unit synchronization in Transform Scale fields when switching from math functions (e.g., calc()) to regular numeric units with sync enabled, ensuring both X and Y axes maintain matching units. Also improved CSS numeric field validation to prevent invalid CSS values when transitioning between value types.
Fixed Theme Builder layout titles in the Visual Builder showing as "Theme Builder Layout" until Theme Builder was saved.
Image module Object Position now transitions smoothly when the Visual Builder settings modal switches between Desktop and Hover.
The Visual Builder canvas and Object Position settings preview now show the correct hover image asset when the Image module uses a different hover-state image source.
Fixed background videos set to display only on hover showing and playing correctly on the frontend and in the Visual Builder.
Fixed a browser crash that could occur when using Find & Replace on very large layouts, especially when replacing one variable with another across many modules.
Fixed missing Layouts option on Tools → Export in Divi 5 by ensuring the library layout post type registers on the WordPress export screen.
Fixed a Visual Builder parity issue where Single Post Content Area Background Color did not render in the builder.
Fixes D5 Visual Builder failing to load on WooCommerce product pages when the iframe had #et-fb-app-body-root but no outer #et-fb-app mount node.
Fixed the Table of Contents to ignore hidden headings and resync after responsive breakpoint changes.

Fixed Role Editor Module Use restrictions in the Divi 5 Visual Builder: aligned permission key resolution across Insert Module and add middleware, hid empty module folders when all children are disabled, and blocked adds for modules disabled for the current role (including Group when divi/group is off).
Fixed an issue where entering line-height values without a unit could incorrectly switch the unit picker to unitless instead of keeping the selected/default unit.
Fixed mobile Theme Customizer body text size being overridden by desktop body font size in Divi 5.
Added Table of Contents module.
Added Instagram Feed module.
Fixed an issue where decimal values (e.g. 0.6x) entered in the Section Divider Horizontal Repeat field were being clamped to 1x.
Fixed off-canvas and WooCommerce Shop page-visit tracking so related display conditions now evaluate correctly across canvases and Shop-targeted rules.
Fixed an issue where locked modules could still be duplicated or deleted by roles without Lock Item permission.
Fixed animations not replaying when re-entering Preview Mode in the Visual Builder.

Woo Product Add To Cart button icons now render configured custom icons consistently in Visual Builder and frontend output, including Font Awesome icons, icon colors, hover/placement settings, disabled-icon output, and normal-page output.
Fixed Icon module Icon Link so the entire module area is clickable and shows a pointer cursor when a link is set, instead of only the icon glyph.
Fixed the testimonial portrait upload control sometimes missing preview and removal for the module’s default portrait image.
Fixed Visual Builder failing to load and Video overlay images in some cases.
Line-height fields in the Visual Builder keep the unitless (—) unit selection after selecting another module and returning to the same element.
Breadcrumbs module: Design → Breadcrumb links styling no longer applies to the Home crumb; Home appearance continues to follow Home Link settings.
Fixed Countdown Timer layout breaking in narrow columns when the day value shows four or more digits (for example 1000+ days remaining).
Fixed Woo Product Stock showing no placeholder text in the Visual Builder when editing Theme Builder product templates with the current product selected.
Fixed responsive style generation for custom breakpoints so breakpoints below the base device now use the correct max-width media queries while preserving visibility behavior.
Menu module Menu Text background color, gradient, and image now apply correctly to top-level navigation links, and the related Menu Text spacing holds on the reported with-logo layout.

The Visual Builder breakpoint pixel input now shows the resolved app frame width for the active device view, including correct updates when switching breakpoints, instead of a stale stored window width value.
Woo Notice module applies a default white button background so View cart and similar notice actions stay visible on the notice bar without opening Design to set a fill.
Fixed sticky options incorrectly appearing usable in the builder when a parent or ancestor used absolute or fixed positioning with center placement, which can break sticky behavior on the front end.

Fixed sticky positioning options being available when parent has absolute or fixed position with center placement (which generates percentage-based positioning like top: 50%). This combination is architecturally incompatible with sticky positioning. The sticky options are now disabled with an explanatory tooltip when the module or its parent has this specific positioning configuration.
Menu module: Setting Logo Max Height under Design → Logo → Sizing now keeps the logo’s aspect ratio instead of stretching it.
Fixed Accordion Item sticky border behavior in Visual Builder preview and frontend sticky state when the parent Accordion is sticky.
Fixed the Background Gradient settings preview incorrectly showing the background image on responsive breakpoints in the Visual Builder.

Fixed Image module alignment on flex layouts by applying flex cross-axis alignment in Visual Builder and on the frontend: responsive preview drift with max height (#49739), and alignment when position is absolute or fixed (#49199).
Fixed an issue where Divi Cloud module items could appear in row library flow and be inserted into a section structure without a row.
Fixed an issue where changing the Text Color on tablet or phone could shift Post Slider content alignment instead of leaving it unchanged.
Fixed button icon hover color not applying when only the hover color was set for modules using button icons.
Resolved an issue where Grid Auto Columns and Grid Auto Rows only accepted a single numeric size instead of full CSS track values like multiple fractional and fixed tracks.
Fixed global number and font variables not rendering on the frontend, which caused broken layout spacing and missing styles on pages using those variables.
Fixed Divi AI image generation panel closing when clicking outside the panel, which caused generated images to disappear from the session until regenerated.
Fixed a Dynamic Content settings modal issue where custom-field settings could appear broken while options were still loading on slower datasets.
Fixed Accordion module click interactions not working correctly in Visual Builder when multiple accordion items had interactions configured.
Fixed Visual Builder column responsive padding by correcting empty-column detection so columns with child modules are no longer treated as empty.
Fixed Layers View going empty when clicking modules on a global off-canvas while editing in the Theme Builder.
Fixed an issue where legacy D4 preset conversion could run repeatedly and clear cache even when no new presets were added.
Fixed incorrect comment count and comment link in the Post Title module’s meta when Show Author was disabled on Theme Builder templates.
Fixed duplicate success messages when the same contact form module appeared more than once on a page after submit (for example in a global off-canvas area rendered twice).
Fixed Load From Library bulk import so unsupported files are skipped with clear singular/plural warnings while supported JSON files remain selected for import.
Fixed background videos being loaded on devices where they were removed, preventing unnecessary bandwidth usage and improving page load performance.
Fixed title-style content in multiple modules (including Heading, CTA, Blurb, Accordion, Slider, and others) so valid HTML displays correctly in the Visual Builder canvas, matching the frontend.
Fixed responsive animation direction in the Visual Builder when animation style stayed on desktop-only settings across breakpoints.
Fixed an issue where Image module alignment controls did not work when the module position was set to absolute.

Fixed Divi 5 migration leaving Backwards Compatibility Mode active when Ultimate Membership Pro (ihc_*) or Divi Booster Menu (db_separators) attributes caused shortcode-module fallback instead of native conversion.
Added the Timeline parent and Timeline Item child modules with aligned FE/VB rendering, split behavior/content ownership, and snapshot-backed coverage for both module surfaces.
Fixed a Chrome section-boundary seam by ensuring linear gradients without image.
Display all authors using ajax on condition setting for authors.
Fixed Author display condition in the Visual Builder only listing the first ten eligible users; additional authors now load while scrolling the author list.
